name: grimmsnarl_ml_v26
policy: v22 is the default policy. v25 supplies a root candidate only in a public same-deck mirror; a three-determinization Search-API rollout advances through the opponent reply and our next turn, and may override only under unanimous value and prize-safety gates. Public wall routes and imminent Lillie deck-outs are handled by deterministic guards.

h2_search.matchup: public Grimmsnarl plus Froslass/Snorunt or Munkidori signature only
h2_search.horizon: current own turn + opponent turn + next own turn
h2_search.acceptance: same winner in every determinization; no sample below v22; no worse two-turn prize exchange; no new deck-out
h2_search.fallback: v22 on every tie, disagreement, missing state, engine error, incomplete branch, or budget stop

proactive_route: concentrate spare Punk Up energy on one Morgrem
complete a one-energy Morgrem without starving the primary attacker
reserve the fifth Bench slot when a third Munkidori would erase the route

deck_clock.scope: turn 10+, optional Lillie refill can empty deck, while ahead or already attack-ready

policy_escalation.effective_runtime: same as v22; the global teacher pin already equals the escalation teacher

known_limits: The H2 opponent policy is used only after both the Grimmsnarl line and this list's Froslass/Snorunt or Munkidori engine are public.
The value model is weakest on turns 1-4 (AUC 0.7196), so H2 is disabled there.
Ladder strength remains unverified until paired v22/v26 submissions are collected in the same window.
description: Conservative real two-ply planner with v22 fallback, v25 peer candidates, and targeted wall/deck-out recovery.
